_comment: web_clipper_diff assertions reference real fixtures/expected/*.md files — actual Obsidian Web Clipper output, kept under their real derived titles (not a generic {{type}}-expected.md name) since filename derivation is itself part of what filename_equals verifies.

test_cases.expected_output: Fetches the URL, climbs the extraction ladder for author/published/description, writes a frozen Resource file with type: article in frontmatter, filename derived from the title in Title Case (per config.json's filenames.resource), reports the file path.

assertions.expected_filename: Claude Code for Designers A Practical Guide.md

assertions.expected_file: fixtures/expected/Claude Code for Designers A Practical Guide.md

test_cases.expected_output: Fetches the URL, resolves author/published/publisher via the extraction ladder, writes a frozen Resource file with type: news and a publisher field in frontmatter, filename derived from the title in Title Case, body as verbatim {{content}} per the News template's bare-variable body.

assertions.expected_filename: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say.md

assertions.expected_file: fixtures/expected/Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say.md

test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL as a Social/Forum thread, writes a frozen Resource file with type: social, bare root_post plus the author's own continuation replies (not other participants' replies), author as display name falling back to handle.
test_cases._no_web_clipper_diff: Real Obsidian Web Clipper has no concept matching continuation (author's own reply-chain) — only single-post text extraction, no schema.org on X/Twitter or Threads. No fair comparison possible; verified by mechanical assertions only.

test_cases.prompt: clip https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1v73ep8/unpopular_opinion_messy_unstructured_prompts_give/, I think it's an article
test_cases.expected_output: Detects the URL is a Reddit thread, notices the conflict with the user's stated type, flags it before writing rather than silently picking either side.

test_cases.prompt: clip this youtube video: https://youtube.com/watch?v=abc123, it has no captions at all
test_cases.expected_output: Attempts youtube-transcript-api, gets NoTranscriptFound or TranscriptsDisabled, reports a clean failure and writes nothing — does not attempt any workaround.

test_cases.prompt: clip this article for me https://example.com/some-post
test_cases.expected_output: Stops before fetching anything, tells the user to run setup-slipbox first, and does not write any file or improvise conventions in config.json's absence — regardless of whether the vault has no .slipbox/ at all, has one with no config.json yet, or has an interrupted/partial setup. clip-resource only ever checks for config.json's presence, so all three states are equivalent from its point of view.
